title: CI evidence by exact SHA

story.i_want_to: read check runs and commit statuses for the checkpoint's exact SHA
story.so_that: a green result on any other commit can never satisfy the gate

rationale: PRD §5; the combined status API never lists check runs.

acceptance_criteria.description: Evidence for a checkpoint is read from both the check-runs and the commit-status APIs for its SHA and copied onto the checkpoint.
A local-gate status is recorded on the checkpoint and never satisfies a required check.
A required check missing, pending or failed on the SHA makes the gate answer unevaluated or refuse, never allow.

test_cases.name: exact SHA
steps: green on the parent, pending on the checkpoint
